svg.text: True, wrap, re-clock, and cut a witness board
Turn an assembled machine into a calibrated one.
Rev B geometry · fab B.3 · inches
Confirm flange BCD before drilling · FABRICATION REVIEW
Paper off: true the drum with the full-width sled until TIR ≤ 0.002″ mid-span
Wrap Velcro, then spiral the paper. Paper thickness is not uniform, so parallel
Paper on: indicate the drum at the drive end (A) and the idler end (B). Bring |A−B|
Sand a witness board at 80 grit, one pass. Caliper four corners. Scatter must be ≤
Then work the pass schedule: 0.008″ rough, 0.004″ medium, 0.001″ finish.
PARTS TRAY — fetch these before you start
TOOLS: Dial indicator + mag base · Calipers · Test panel · Respirator
OPEN THESE SHEETS: Q-101 · P-013 · A-02
BEFORE YOU MOVE ON (QC-06 · QC-07 · QC-10)
HOLD POINT: First powered run: hood on, no stock, stand clear
of the drum ends, hand on the switch.
Still correctable after this step: Everything that matters —
which is why you re-clock after every paper change.
⚠ Do not sand stock shorter than about 12″ without the sled.
Hands never under the drum or the hold-downs.
